m2-tourn4.title: Tournament (Hard)
m2-tourn4.html:
Tournament

Five neighbourhood futsal sides — Rovers, Strikers, Comets, Titans, Wanderers — played a single round-robin: each pair met exactly once. A win was worth 4 points, a draw 1 point, and a loss 0.

The following is known:

  • Wanderers won exactly three matches.
  • Exactly two matches in the league ended in a draw.
  • Rovers won exactly one match.
  • Comets drew exactly one match.
  • Titans finished with 16 points.
